_note: Terrain pass v2 (owner 2026-10-13: war-torn, hurried wartime construction, shinier). size = [w, d, h] inches, the engine footprint and height; the long side is +x. prompt = what the piece is (the shared style words live in t_concepts.py).

outpost-bunker.prompt: a battle-damaged two storey military command bunker, scorched riveted steel plates, shell holes, sandbag walls stacked around the doorway, steel scaffolding on one side, hazard stripes

outpost-comm-tower.prompt: a square fortified communications post with a bent radio mast, patched armour plating welded over holes, sandbag parapet on the roof, steel ladder and catwalk, blast scorch marks

outpost-depot.prompt: a half-ruined military supply depot hangar with a partly collapsed corrugated steel roof, exposed girders, piled crates and fuel drums inside, sandbags along the front, shell damage

outpost-generator.prompt: a square armoured power generator station with big pipes and exhaust stacks, dented steel panels, improvised scrap-plate armour, sandbags and barbed wire around the base, battle damage

outpost-barricade.prompt: a long low wartime barricade of stacked sandbags reinforced with welded scrap steel plates and wooden posts, straight line, battle worn

outpost-gate-fence.prompt: a long straight improvised steel wall made of riveted scrap armour plates bolted to girders, bullet holes, a few sandbags at its foot, straight line

outpost-blast-wall.prompt: a very long tall straight military blast wall of heavy concrete and steel segments, cracked and shell-damaged, steel scaffolding and a catwalk behind it, hazard stripes

outpost-fuel-tanks.prompt: two dented military fuel tanks on a steel skid with pipes and valves, one tank holed and scorched, a few sandbags beside them

outpost-crate-stack.prompt: a hasty pile of military ammunition crates, steel cargo boxes and oil drums with a tarp, some crates broken open, sandbags

outpost-containers.prompt: the burnt-out wreck of a six-wheeled armoured military transport vehicle, blown open hull, scorched steel, flat tyres

outpost-silo.prompt: a round cratered gun emplacement ringed with sandbags and curved scrap steel plates, a wrecked twin autocannon turret in the middle

outpost-dish.prompt: a round damaged sensor dish platform on a steel tripod, bent dish, cables, a ring of sandbags and scrap plates around the base
